description.to:
Outcome: Extends PPY-9378c7 with exact steps. Day -1: lower the TTL of the threat-intelligence.anth.us alias record to 60 s; announce the freeze. Day 0: (1) put TI's newsroom in read-only (banner); (2) final copy-backend --stamp-tenant --apply twice, the second run must change nothing; (3) add threat-intelligence.anth.us as a custom domain of the tenant (anth.us zone is in papyrus-production), certificate issued, KVS entry written; (4) switch the alias from TI's distribution (E20NJAIXZ1WKWD) to the shared distribution; (5) verify: update-live on one story, 50 sampled URLs, sitemap, feeds, Markdown twins, a monitor delivery; (6) open the tenant's newsroom on the shared host to TI's editors. Rollback (any time in 14 days): switch the alias back, lift TI's old read-only, and copy any edits made on the shared stack back with copy-backend in reverse (rehearsed in PPY-e1d26f). No blanket invalidation at any step.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): TI edge (infra/edge/threat-intelligence-amplify-origin.yaml pattern), Route 53 anth.us zone, the shared edge, copy-backend, docs runbook page.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/ti-cutover.feature):
Scenario: A bad cut-over can be reversed without losing edits
    Given TI has run on the shared stack for 2 days with 3 new stories
    When the operator rolls back
    Then readers see the old site within the TTL with the 3 stories, and no URL errors

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-e1d26f, PPY-966722, PPY-f7ce77, PPY-7438d9, PPY-7e396d. Blocks PPY-16f13a. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-9378c7, PPY-32b4c5.

Testing: The rehearsal ran the same steps against staging; the verification list is a script.
Rollout: Production, with Ryan's go-ahead on the day (production DNS and data).
Risk and mitigation: Risk: DNS change on a shared root zone. Mitigation: alias switch inside our own zone (not an Amplify domain association), TTL lowered a day ahead, old distribution untouched for 14 days.

Releasable on its own: no (an operation, not a release).
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
